one_liner: CivicState has real MVP code but remains watchlist until business identity, paid demand, and delivery safety are proven.
thesis: CivicState can become a small paid civic-letter completion business if users pay $5-$25 for verified, delivered, official-directed correspondence and the operator can control deliverability and legal-adjacent AI risk.

verdict.label: watchlist
verdict.scoreLabel: assumption: EIR judgment; no network access
verdict.rationale: Implementation is stronger than the stale planning audit, but the registry note, identity mismatch, absent market proof, local official stub, and deliverability/legal risks block investibility.

evidence.finding: Repo is named civicstate and describes an AI-powered civic advocacy platform.
Existing soul defines CivicState as a $5-$25 civic letter product.
Stripe checkout pricing tiers are implemented.
Core user, submission, campaign, letter, official, payment, delivery, ledger, audit, and job models exist.
Local official lookup remains a stub.

assumptions: Market size is modeled bottom-up because no network research was available.
Competitor references are model-knowledge assumptions, not verified current market research.
Paid willingness to pay is unvalidated until beta checkout data exists.
Operator review load is unvalidated until real flagged submissions exist.
operatorRulingNeeded: Confirm whether brooks-history should map to CivicState or be renamed/archived.
Confirm whether this personal/research asset should be pitched as a business.
Approve beta safety thresholds before public promotion.
nextReviewTrigger: After operator ruling or paid beta data is available.
